title: Optical Image Collection
author: Guanshi Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beumjeu6
materials: Dehydrate slides with 95% ethanol for 00:01:00 to 00:02:00 95% Ethanol Thermo Scientific
Slides are then re-stained with PAS

Dehydrate by the successive ethanol and xylene steps 14 to 18 and coverslip using a synthetic mounting medium. 75% Ethanol Contributed by users 95% Ethanol Thermo Scientific 100% Ethanol Contributed by users Xylene Contributed by users Coverslips Contributed by users Chemical Permount Mounting Medium Fisher Scientific Catalog #SP15-100

steps.title: Air Dry Slides
steps.instruction: Air dry slides (after storage at -80 °C) under the hood for 00:03:00 to 00:05:00.

steps.title: Fix Slides
steps.instruction: Fix slides in ice cold acetone:methanol solution (1:1) for 00:10:00 to 00:15:00 at -20 °C.

steps.title: Wash and Rehydrate
steps.instruction: Wash/rehydrate slides in distilled H2O for 00:10:00 to 00:15:00.

steps.title: Perform Hematoxylin Staining
steps.instruction: Stain slides with Mayers hematoxylin solution for 00:00:20 to 00:00:30.

steps.title: First Water Wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides with distilled H2O for 00:02:00.

steps.title: Differentiate Staining
steps.instruction: Rinse slides with Mastertech Differentiating Solution (Catalog #HXD00188E) by moving slides up and down 3-4 times within 00:00:05.

substeps.instruction: Check intensity of nuclear staining under the microscope.
If signal is too weak, repeat staining for 00:00:05 to 00:00:10, then rinse slides with distilled water again for 00:00:01 to 00:00:02.

steps.title: Second Water Wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides with distilled H2O for 00:02:00.

steps.title: Apply Bluing Solution
steps.instruction: Rinse slides with Mastertech Bluing Solution (American Master Tech Scientific Catalog #HXB00288E) by moving slides up and down for 00:00:05 to 00:00:10.

steps.title: Third Water Wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides with distilled H2O for 00:02:00.

steps.title: Perform Eosin Staining
steps.instruction: Stain slides with Eosin Solution for 00:00:15 to 00:00:20.

steps.title: Wash and Dehydrate with Ethanol
steps.instruction: Perform sequential ethanol dehydration of the slides.

substeps.instruction: Wash/dehydrate slides with 75% ethanol for 00:01:00 to 00:02:00.
Dehydrate slides with 100% ethanol for 00:02:00 (perform twice).

steps.title: Xylene Immersion
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in xylene for 00:02:00 (perform twice).

steps.title: Final Air Dry
steps.instruction: Air dry slides under the hood for 00:03:00 to 00:05:00.

steps.title: Mount and Cover Sections
steps.instruction: Mount sections with Chemical Permount Mounting Medium (Fisher Scientific Catalog #SP15-100) and cover with coverslips.

steps.title: Image and Register H&E Slides
steps.instruction: Image stained samples using an Aperio ScanScope XT, upload H&E images to METASPACE, and register them to the corresponding MSI data.

steps.title: Formalin Fixation
steps.instruction: Place the slides in 10% formalin in 95% alcohol for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Oxidize Sections
steps.instruction: Oxidize in 0.5% periodic acid solution (0.5g periodic acid in 100mL DI water) for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Tap Water Rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse in tap water four times.

steps.title: Apply Schiff Reagent
steps.instruction: Place in Schiff’s reagent (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #3952016-500ML) for 00:15:00 until sections become a light pink color.

steps.title: Lukewarm Water Wash
steps.instruction: Wash in lukewarm tap water for 00:05:00 until sections immediately become a dark pink color.

steps.title: PAS Counterstain
steps.instruction: Counterstain in Mayers hematoxylin solution for 00:03:00.

steps.title: Final PAS Rinses
steps.instruction: Rinse in TBS solution and then rinse in deionized water four times.

steps.title: Image and Register PAS Slides
steps.instruction: Image PAS slides (from the same tissue section as the H&E slide) using Aperio ScanScope XT, upload to METASPACE, and register to the corresponding data.

steps.title: Final Tap Water Rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse in tap water four times.

steps.title: Capture Pre-AF Image
steps.instruction: Capture AF image (pre-AF) on a confocal microscope after defrosting in desiccator and before matrix application.

substeps.instruction: Use UTHSA: 10x objective on Leica TSC SP8, PNNL: 20x objective on Zeiss 710 LSM, or 10x objective PALM MicroBeam (Zeiss inverse microscope Axiovert).
Use 495 nm-720 nm, 404-488 nm and bright field channels with pinhole size 239 μm.
Upload AF image to METASPACE and register to corresponding MSI data.

steps.title: Matrix Application and MALDI-MSI
steps.instruction: Perform matrix application and MALDI-MSI (duplicates for each sample at each spatial resolution).
